name: nvidia-explainer-video
description: 60-second 1080x1920 NVIDIA investment explainer built with Remotion

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts NvidiaExplainer out/nvidia-explainer.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --audio-codec aac --audio-bitrate 320k
scripts.master: ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/nvidia-explainer.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -c:a aac -b:a 320k -ar 48000 -movflags +faststart out/nvidia-explainer-final.mp4
